verdict.rationale: Anthropic publishes an explicit open spec (agentskills.io) defining SKILL.md structure with required YAML frontmatter (name, description) and folder conventions (scripts/, references/, assets/), plus a ready-to-use template file and a dedicated 'skill-creator' skill for authoring and iterating on new skills, none of which requires reverse-engineering existing skills. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer account confirming the template and spec alone (without inspecting example skills) sufficed to author a working skill.
